main.description: Close a public scene. Service auth must come from the acting member's PDS for the World DID or the World's #motet_tenor service and this exact method. The actor needs the World's current RPC grant. The public record and admission rules change atomically; closed scenes refuse new posts. Repeating an operation with the same input returns its original result; reusing its ID for different input is refused.

op.description: A caller-chosen operation ID, unique to this World and actor.

swapRecord.description: The current scene CID. A stale value is refused.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The actor is not authorized to close this World's scenes.

errors.name: NotFound
errors.description: The public scene or repository was not found.

errors.name: InvalidSwap
errors.description: The scene record changed since swapRecord.
